The '''Dune Walker''' was a modified version of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was specifically designed to serve on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with hot climates.

==Characteristics==
[[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] were often modified to be more effective in certain missions. For this purpose, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] equipped them with special components for specific environments.<ref name="TNEGtVaV" />

The Dune Walker was one such variant which was adapted for hot climates. This [[Desert/Legends|desert]] terrain [[Walker/Legends|walker]] was modified by replacing its tertiary weapons systems with additional [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar]] [[z23 heat dissipation unit]]s.<ref name="CCG" /> These modifications allowed the Dune Walker to perform long marches on hot [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="TNEGtVaV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dune Walker was created for the ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], which was released on [[November]] of [[1998]].<ref name="CCG" />
